title: 第二章白费功夫
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“他就是绑架案的凶手。”

“你们快去把他抓捕归案。”

赵宇和陆云铮两人顺着黎雾的手指朝刀疤脸所在的位置看去，此时刀疤脸正站在便利店门口拿着一只烟吞云吐雾，眉头不由得皱了皱。

虽然这人长相凶恶了一点，但是他们也不能没有任何证据就直接抓人。

陆云铮薄唇抿直，开口道：

“黎女士，您说他就是绑架案的凶手，请问您这边是有什么证据吗？”

“有证据可以先给我们，后期确认属实之后，会为您申请奖励。”

徐首富为了能够找到自己的独女线索，直接给出一百万一条线索的天价。

黎雾自然也想要那一百万。

有了一百万，作为社恐她就再也不用出门，可以顺顺利利地躺平一辈子了。

黎雾脸上闪过一丝尴尬。

她哪里有什么线索。

她唯一的线索就是自己的眼睛。

她能跟面前的两个警察说，是她眼睛看到了刀疤脸头上顶着【绑架案凶手】几个字吗？

她不能。

怕不是马上把她当做寻衅生事、报假警的人抓起来。

想到这里，黎雾不由得着急道：

“我没有证据，但是你相信我，他真的是绑架案凶手，你们把他抓回去一审，就什么都知道了。”

黎雾这模样，实在太像没事找事、无理取闹的人了。

赵警官不由得眉头皱了皱，严肃道：

“黎女士，你知不知道这次绑架案全国关注，上面只给我们十天时间。”

“我们没有时间陪你在这里玩，你再这样，小心我以妨碍公务为由把你抓起来。”

整个云城警局上下都在为了徐倩文绑架案给忙来忙去，徐倩文的社交记录和云城游玩监控都被看了好几遍，都没有找到一点线索。

好不容易今天接到电话说有线索，他们急匆匆赶来，没想到是黎雾在跟她们闹着玩。

这边赵警官严肃警告了黎雾后就准备离开，那边刀疤脸抽完烟朝路边的出租车招招手，就准备上车。

对于黎雾来说，她已经做到自己能做的了，也可以直接离开当做无事发生。

毕竟她是社恐。

刚刚鼓足勇气报警，和赵警官交谈，就已经耗费了她不小的勇气。

当做无事发生，才是最好的结果。

黎雾深吸一口气，看着刀疤脸头顶那极其鲜明显眼标红加粗的【绑架案凶手】五个字后，抿了抿唇。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"He is the murderer of the kidnapping."

"Go and arrest him quickly."

Zhao Yu and Lu Yunzheng followed Li Wu's fingers and looked towards where Scarface was. At this time, Scarface was standing at the door of the convenience store, puffing away a cigarette and frowning.

Although this person looks a little more vicious, they can't just arrest him without any evidence.

Lu Yunzheng straightened his thin lips and said:

"Ms. Li, you said he was the murderer of the kidnapping case. Do you have any evidence here?"

"If you have any evidence, you can give it to us first. After it is confirmed to be true later, we will apply for a reward for you."

In order to find clues to his only daughter, the richest man, Xu, directly offered a sky-high price of one million for each clue.

Li Wu naturally also wanted the one million.

With one million, as a social worker, she would never have to go out again and could live smoothly for the rest of her life.

A trace of embarrassment flashed across Li Wu's face.

Where does she have any clues?

Her only clue was her eyes.

Could she tell the two policemen in front of her that she saw the words "Kidnapping Murderer" on Scarface's head?

She can't.

I'm afraid she won't be arrested immediately as someone who caused trouble and made a false police report.

Thinking of this, Li Wu couldn't help but said anxiously:

"I have no evidence, but believe me, he is really the murderer of the kidnapping case. If you take him back and interrogate him, you will know everything."

Li Wu looked too much like someone who was looking for trouble and making trouble without reason.

Officer Zhao couldn't help but frown and said seriously:

"Ms. Li, do you know that this kidnapping case is attracting nationwide attention and we are only given ten days?"

"We don't have time to play with you here. If you do this again, I'll arrest you for obstructing official business."

The entire Yuncheng Police Department was busy working on the Xu Qianwen kidnapping case. Xu Qianwen's social records and Yuncheng travel surveillance were reviewed several times, but no clues were found.

Finally, they received a call today saying they had clues. They rushed over in a hurry, but they didn't expect that it was Li Wu who was playing tricks on them.

Here, Officer Zhao gave Li Wu a serious warning and was about to leave. Over there, Scarface finished his cigarette and waved to the taxi on the roadside, ready to get in the car.

For Li Wu, she had done what she could do, and she could just leave and pretend that nothing happened.

After all, she is a sociopath.

She had just mustered up the courage to call the police and talk to Officer Zhao, but it had taken a lot of courage for her.

Assuming nothing happens is the best outcome.

Li Wu took a deep breath, looked at the extremely distinctive red and bold words "Kidnapping Murderer" above Scar's face, and pursed his lips.
